setup.title: Quick setup
setup.step1: Open @BotFather in Telegram → /newbot → follow the steps → get the Bot Token.
setup.step2: Create a group and add the bot to it (make it an admin so it can post).
setup.step3: Send one message in the group, then get the group Chat ID (e.g. via @userinfobot / @getidsbot, or open {{url}} and take the chat.id starting with -100…).
setup.step4: Enter the Token & Chat ID above → Save → Test Connection.
